title: Day view
caption: The day view: today's agenda, a timeline of the day and the month at a glance.

title: Week view
caption: A week with work, personal, sports and family events side by side.

title: Month view
caption: October at a glance: work, personal, sports and the shared family calendar, holidays and an all-day trip.

title: Year planner
caption: The whole year on one page: public and school holidays, vacations and the first event of every day.

title: Free weekends
caption: Every weekend of the year, free or planned, with long weekends extended by a public holiday.

title: Vacation planner
caption: Vacations against school and public holidays, with planned and remaining vacation days.

title: Countdown wall
caption: Days until the next birthdays, vacations and holidays.

title: Year in numbers
caption: Statistics of the year: events per calendar, load per week, busy evenings and weekends.

caption: Tasks grouped by due date, with progress and categories and the task editor docked beside the list.

title: Task table
caption: All tasks as a sortable table with configurable columns.

title: Task board
caption: A kanban board: tasks in columns by status.

title: Task timeline
caption: Tasks with a start and a due date as bars on a timeline.

title: Task deck
caption: One task at a time as a card deck, worked through with the keyboard.

title: Completed tasks
caption: What got done: completed tasks by day with a heat map.

title: Contacts
caption: The address book as a list with a letter rail, the selected contact beside it.

title: Contacts table
caption: The address book as a table with phone, email, categories and birthdays.

caption: An event opened read-only: its day beside it, time, location, people, a reminder and a note.

title: Event (edit mode)
caption: The same event in edit mode: every property as an editable card.

title: Task (view mode)
caption: A task opened read-only: start and due date, progress, a category and a note.

title: Task (edit mode)
caption: The same task in edit mode.

title: Contact (view mode)
caption: A contact opened read-only: phone, email, address, organisation, birthday and a note.

title: Contact (edit mode)
caption: The same contact in edit mode.

title: Colour manager
caption: Every colour in use: calendars, holidays, category rules, and events and tasks with a colour of their own.

caption: Suggestions to merge near-duplicate colours and pull apart colours that look alike, as a flow from element to new colour.

title: Universal search
caption: One search box for events, contacts and tasks, with results from all three.

title: Month view (dark)
caption: The month view in dark mode.

title: Settings
caption: The settings start page: language, colour scheme, holiday regions, vacation, reminders, calendars, categories and groups.

caption: The rule of the category "Work": every event with this category gets a 15-minute reminder and the office as its location.

caption: A weekly event in edit mode: the repeat card with its preview calendar, and the colour that the category rule "Sports" sets.

caption: The change history as a list: an undone change with its before and after values, and the history of that event.

title: Connected devices
caption: Connected devices: add a device, and every connected device with its own password.

caption: A group and its members: every member may add or remove members and manage the group's calendars.

caption: An .ics file picked for import: name, colour and time zone come from the file and can be changed before the import.
